about.title: About me
about.personalDescription:
I'm Nguyen Phuc Thanh, a Mobile Developer based in Hanoi and a Multimedia Engineering graduate from Hanoi University of Science and Technology. I work with Flutter, React Native, and native Android, and I've built an Expo native module in Kotlin and Swift.

At Kalapa JSC, I develop eKYC SDKs for mobile banking apps, including integrations for Shinhan Bank and VPBank. I build demo apps for partner integrations and internal QA, and work with bank engineering teams on device compatibility and performance.

At eUp Group, I worked on the Android app for HeyJapan, a Japanese-learning app with over 10 million learners worldwide. My work covered learning flows, advertising, in-app purchases, analytics, and feature rollouts.

Beyond phone apps, I've built kiosk and face terminal software for identity verification, attendance tracking, and access control. I also helped build a web dashboard for monitoring those devices and updating them remotely.

services.title: Connected Devices and Web Tools
services.description: Integrate cameras, NFC readers, and biometrics into kiosks and face terminals. Build web dashboards and backend services for device monitoring and remote updates.

mobileStarterKits.description: Four app starters and three SDK starters for Android, Flutter, and React Native. The Android app starters cover both Jetpack Compose and XML/ViewBinding. The SDK starters include typed errors and example host apps.

deskBridge.description: Share a Mac’s mouse and keyboard with Android by moving across the screen edge. DeskBridge relays input over USB or Wi-Fi, syncs clipboard text in both directions, and is available via GitHub and Homebrew.

viettel.description: Android kiosk for Viettel that verifies IDs and passports using MRZ OCR, NFC chip reading, and face matching. It integrates digital signing and VNPAY sandbox QR payments.

fileRecovery.description: Native Android app for scanning, previewing, and restoring deleted media without root. Built with Kotlin, Hilt, Coroutines, and Android Scoped Storage, with an in-app advertising SDK.

deviceManagement.description: Android OTA agent and monitoring dashboard for SunGroup’s SunWorld face terminals, with device telemetry, real-time status, and remote APK updates.

coffeeShop.description: Coffee shop website and mobile app – a full-stack system (React / Node.js / MySQL + React Native) with role-based access, product browsing, and feedback management.

raincaster.description: Raincaster – a real-time weather forecasting platform leveraging an SVM model with a Flask backend and React frontend, focused on rainfall prediction.

dsoft.description: DSoft – a Flutter-based spa and wellness management application supporting appointment bookings, staff scheduling, inventory tracking, payments, and business analytics.
